scope: Dependency audit and controlled updates — no blind upgrades; current-main revalidation after Stage 52.
decision: No bulk dependency upgrades. package-lock.json remains the source of truth. Dependency changes stay isolated by coupling boundary and require manifest/lockfile review plus regression evidence before merge.

contracts.lockfile: package-lock.json remains mandatory and reviewed with every dependency mutation
contracts.noBlind: No bulk or major upgrade without stage-scoped coupling analysis and regression tests
contracts.securityGate: root npm audit critical/high blocking remains enabled
contracts.sbomGate: CycloneDX SBOM generation remains fail-closed in the security pipeline
contracts.shaRule: Any package.json/package-lock/test/config/workflow change creates a new final SHA and requires a fresh 0/1 PR gate cycle

verification.passA: Manifest, lockfile, Node engine, Prisma declarations and security-relevant overrides crosschecked on current main.
verification.passB: Previously isolated Stage 54-56 dependency and bundle follow-ups remain separated; no blind upgrade wave is reintroduced.
